measure.title: Create a measure
measure.intro:
A measure defines where the data for KPIs comes from.
Follow these steps to set it up correctly.

context.title: Context
context.desc: The context indicates the area in which the measure is used.

name.title: Name
name.desc:
Use a clear name:
It will be displayed in the KPIs.

type.title: Type
type.desc:
The type indicates how to retrieve the data
(API REST, database).

description.title: Description
description.desc:
Enter an optional description to explain the purpose of the measure.
It will help you understand it when reusing it in KPIs.

method.title: Method
method.desc:
Select the HTTP method used to call the REST endpoint.

GET retrieves data.
POST sends data to the server.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.desc: Defines the communication protocol used to connect to the data source.

url.title: URL
url.desc:
Specify the data source address.
The protocol is handled automatically.

mapping.title: JsonPath
mapping.desc: Here you define how to extract the numeric value from the response or database.

security.title: Private connection
security.desc: Enable this option if the source is protected or only accessible with credentials.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.desc:
Enter the credentials required to access the data.
The information is stored securely.

end.title: End
end.desc:
Great!
You can now use this measure to create one or more KPIs.
